title: Devmali gaon secret part 3
lines: Devmali gaon ka wo sach jo wahan ke log bhi chupate hain!
Part one aur two mein aapne dekha ki yahan ek bhi pakka ghar kyun nahi banta.
Lekin asli rahasya toh abhi baaki hai.
Gaon ke buzurgon ka kehna hai ki yahan raat ko ek aisi aawaz sunai deti hai, jo kisi insaan ki nahi hoti.
Aur sabse ajeeb baat yeh hai ki aaj tak kisi ne bhi gaon ke andar raat ko roshni jalate hue nahi dekha.
Kya yeh kisi shrap ka asar hai, ya phir zameen ke neeche kuch dabha hua hai?
Agar agla part dekhna hai toh jaldi se subscribe karo, warna agla rahasya miss ho jayega!
